dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.platform.os.isWindows>
<!description: Replace Platform.getOS().equals(Platform.OS_WIN32) with Platform.OS.isWindows() for idiomatic OS check.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!minJavaVersion: 8>

org.eclipse.core.runtime.Platform.getOS().equals(org.eclipse.core.runtime.Platform.OS_WIN32)
=>
org.eclipse.core.runtime.Platform.OS.isWindows()
;;
summary: Replace direct Platform.getOS().equals(Platform.OS_WIN32) call with the new idiomatic Platform.OS.isWindows() helper method.
